high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "thepulseindia." The post features a news article headline that reads, "Why is this letter a letter bomb?" The content of the article discusses a letter written by someone named Jakhar, who expressed fear that if the court ruled in favor of Sodhi, it would cause incalculable damage to Congress's image as well as its poll prospects. The article mentions that the issue has surfaced at a time when hundreds of farmers are protesting to get compensation enhanced to ₹70 lakh (Indian Rupees 70 lakhs) from ₹45 lakh
